2607.14149.title: Enhancing Small Language Models Reasoning through Knowledge Graph Grounding
2607.14149.paper_summary: Although large language models (LLMs) have set benchmarks for zero-shot reasoning, their deployment remains cost-prohibitive and environmentally taxing. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a sustainable alternative, but prone to errors, on tasks requiring complex, multi-hop logical grounding. We investigate a neuro-symbolic agentic framework to enhance the reasoning capabilities of SLMs, specifically Gemma 3 (1B, 4B) and Llama 3.2 (3B), using the CLUTRR kinship benchmark. Our approach transforms the SLM into a minimalist agent utilizing two specialized tool calls: extract_facts for symbolic triplet extraction and get_hint for expert reasoning via a Relational Graph Convolutional Network (RGCN). We evaluate these models across two configurations, both in an Oracle scenario with ground-truth triplets and a Realistic scenario relying on self-extracted knowledge. Our results reveal that while RGCN-derived hints provide a 1.5 - 2x performance gain over story-only baselines, the system is constrained by the extraction bottleneck and sequential deductive fragility, where early extraction errors compound over multi-hop chains. Furthermore, we identify a "distraction effect" in specific architectures where noisy, self-generated facts degrade performance despite the presence of expert hints. This work characterizes the challenges of symbolic grounding in low-resource agentic systems and provides a roadmap for iterative verification in neuro-symbolic agentic pipelines.
2607.14149.paper_summary_zh: 儘管大型語言模型（LLMs）已經為零-shot 推理設定了基準，但其部署仍然成本高昂且對環境造成負擔。小型語言模型（SLMs）提供了一種可持續的替代方案，但在需要複雜的多跳邏輯基礎的任務中容易出錯。我們研究了一種神經符號代理框架，以增強 SLMs 的推理能力，特別是 Gemma 3（1B，4B）和 Llama 3.2（3B），使用 CLUTRR 親屬基準。我們的方法將 SLM 轉變為一個極簡主義代理，利用兩個專門的工具調用：extract_facts 用於符號三元組提取，get_hint 用於通過關係圖卷積網絡（RGCN）進行專家推理。我們在兩種配置下評估這些模型，分別是在具有真實三元組的 Oracle 情境和依賴自我提取知識的現實情境。我們的結果顯示，雖然 RGCN 衍生的提示在故事僅基準上提供了 1.5 - 2 倍的性能提升，但系統受到提取瓶頸和序列推理脆弱性的限制，早期提取錯誤在多跳鏈中累積。此外，我們在特定架構中識別出一種「干擾效應」，在這些架構中，雜訊自生成的事實儘管存在專家提示，卻降低了性能。這項工作描述了在低資源代理系統中符號基礎的挑戰，並為神經符號代理管道中的迭代驗證提供了路線圖。
